svg.title: What the No Slop Claude Code skill changes
svg.desc: Without No Slop, the user chooses skills manually, broad rules can flatten their voice, downloaded copies can age, corrections can be forgotten, and final review can be skipped. With No Slop, one Claude Code skill chooses the path, runs source skills in order, applies personal voice and taste, keeps community updates reviewable, saves approved corrections, and can check the final review with an optional hook.

g.text: One Claude Code skill coordinates the route, the order, the updates, and the final review.
Good tools, but you manage the process.
You decide which writing or interface skill to use.
Broad cleanup rules can erase choices that sound like you.
Source copies and one-time corrections can become stale.
Nothing makes the last review difficult to skip.
One route, with your voice kept in control.
Chooses the writing or interface path from the request.
Runs the source skills before your personal rules and examples.
Proposes community-skill updates for you to review.
Saves approved voice and taste corrections for later work.
Can check a missed final review with the optional Stop hook.
Source skills can improve. Approved personal corrections can carry forward.
